displayAddress: Richard Hawthorn House, Geoffrey Watling Way
description:
Two bedroom Ground floor Apartment in Richard Hawthorn House down by the River!

Leaders are delighted to present this stunning two bedroom ground floor apartment with a private terrace in one of Riversides newest developments! The is an ideal buy for both home buyers and investors.

As you enter this light and airy apartment you come into the main hallway, with storage to both your left and right you'll never be short of space. The modern three piece bathroom is round the corner with a shower over bath, basin, sink and towel rail. 

Both bedrooms are to the rear overlooking the terrace and communal garden. The main living area is an open plan style kitchen diner with sliding doors to the private terrace. The fitted kitchen has integrated appliances being an oven, hobs, extractor, fridge/freezer and washing machine. The apartment is currently being offered part furnished. 

Richard Hawthorn House has the added benefit of a spacious garden terrace. The apartment has parking available at an additional cost.
